summary: Turn an idea into a live webpage in minutes, no code and no hosting setup. Use when a non-technical user wants to publish a webpage, landing page, one-pager, portfolio, or any simple site to the internet, or says things like put my idea online, publish my website, host my page, share my idea, or make a landing page. The agent writes the page, packages it, deploys to goclawgo, and returns a shareable URL.
